source_refs.locator: PDF p. 55, section 7 on permafrost active-layer thickness in Western Siberia.

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2025 reports: For two monitored sites in Nadym district, Roshydromet reports positive active-layer-thickness trends of 58 and 45 cm per decade over 2005–2024.

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2025 reports: Spring-cereal growing-season precipitation in 2024 was 36% below its 1991–2020 normal in the Southern District and 30% below in the North Caucasus; local soil drought was possible in both during June–August.
